description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Translation' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Design' namespace. The class handles CRUD operations (list, form, save) for translation entries in the OpenCart admin panel. It extends a base controller and interacts with models, views, and language resources to facilitate translation management, including listing translations, editing/adding a translation, and saving updates.
